The beef heart guy is a man who delivered cow's hearts for the Valentine's Day lunch at Springfield Elementary School. At Doris Freedman's request, he dumped the hearts on the floor of the lunchroom.

page.overview:
Who is Beef heart guy?

The beef heart guy is a man who delivered cow's hearts for the Valentine's Day lunch at Springfield Elementary School. At Doris Freedman's request, he dumped the hearts on the floor of the lunchroom.
